prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady ascent along a rugged, rocky trail on the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal. The viewer's feet move forward, navigating over uneven terrain scattered with stones and sparse vegetation. As the climb progresses, the camera pans slightly to reveal a breathtaking view of snow-capped mountains shrouded in mist, dominating the horizon under a clear blue sky. The path becomes increasingly steep, transitioning from rocky ground to patches of snow and ice, requiring careful steps to maintain balance. The surrounding landscape features a mix of exposed rock faces and snow-covered slopes, with occasional trees clinging to the edges. The camera angle shifts subtly, capturing the expansive vista and the dramatic drop-offs on either side of the trail. The lighting is bright, casting sharp shadows that highlight the textures of the rocks and snow. The scene remains serene and untouched, with no other individuals in sight, emphasizing the solitude and raw beauty of this high-altitude environment. As the journey continues, the camera captures the intricate details of the trail, from the crunching sound of footsteps on snow to the distant peaks that seem to stretch endlessly into the distance.
